card.name: Scattered words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on unrelated words such as the start of Sappho, small words like 'the' or 'for' in political text, and words after 'international'.

modes.label: Start of Sappho
modes.description: The 'app' piece inside the name Sappho or Sapphist.

modes.label: Linking words in politics
modes.description: Small words like 'for' or 'the' in sentences about diplomacy and state affairs.
modes.example: One of the most important principles is not to interfere in<< the>> internal affairs of other countries.
